logos.note: Mapped by pixels: #5D29F0 symbol, #000000 wordmark, transparent background. The bundle's ...wordmark2 copy is the same art on white.

logos.gap: No bundle file is purple-on-purple: every wordmark is on a transparent or white background. the brand design lead to supply or retire the row.
logos.use: Purple-on-purple. For brand-color surfaces where the default mark would lose contrast.

logos.note: Mapped by use (bright or neutral surfaces) and pixels: #000000 lockup on a transparent background. The Notion use text says white-on-light; the name reads background-foreground.
logos.use: White-on-light. For bright or neutral surfaces where strong contrast is required.

logos.note: Mapped by use (dark surfaces) and pixels: #FFFFFF lockup on a transparent background, the only light lockup in the bundle.
logos.use: Black-on-dark surfaces. Optimized for low-light UI or dark themes.

rules: Use weight for hierarchy, not multiple typefaces: Bold or Black for headlines, Medium for subheads, Regular for body copy, Light for secondary metadata (Notion); Brand Guidelines V.2 p.27 lists Regular and Medium only.
Maintain breathing room: generous line height and margin create clarity and authority.
Typography should feel engineered, not stylized.

avoid.name: Marketing speak
avoid.text: Terms like "revolutionary," "game-changing," and "best-in-class" are vague. Describe what the product actually does.

avoid.name: Corporate language
avoid.text: We don't "leverage synergies" or "drive value." We build tools that work.

avoid.name: Overpromising
avoid.text: If something is in beta, say so. If there are limitations, mention them. Accuracy builds more credibility than enthusiasm.

avoid.name: Condescension
avoid.text: Assume the reader is capable but may be learning this specific topic.

voice.note: Same text as the Notion page (Voice and tone): summary, four principles, four things to avoid, and the five-row quick reference. Only the punctuation of the summary differs.

principles.name: Direct
principles.text: Say what we mean concisely. If something is complex, acknowledge it. If it's simple, say so.

principles.name: Technical but accessible
principles.text: We respect our audience's intelligence. Use technical terms when appropriate, but explain when context helps.

principles.name: Useful
principles.text: Every piece of content should leave the reader better informed or more capable.

principles.name: Confident without arrogance
principles.text: We know our strengths. We also acknowledge what we're still improving.

voice.summary: We sound like a senior engineer explaining something to a peer. Technical, direct, helpful. Never condescending, never vague, never filled with buzzwords.

swaps.write: AI infrastructure that scales with you
